name: Kutsuna Sakura
source:
A girl who runs a "Self-Proclaimed School Lunch Committee" - an organization that doesn't officially exist in her high school. She has an exceptional passion for food, extending her awareness to eating, nutrition, and even exercises for health. The committee operates as a charitable activity within the school, providing meals for students who cannot eat satisfactorily, which is why Mari occasionally drops by.

DeepSeek translated from https://static.camp-fire.jp/uploads/editor_uploaded_image/image/4780098/02_sakura.png?ixlib=rails-2.1.4&fit=max&auto=format
